title: smtp drain: authenticated sessions for SmtpListId local-only routing
description: Until authenticated SMTP drain sessions exist, X-Stoa-Injection-Source headers from the drain cannot be trusted (see stoa-50ccf401 fix). All NNTP POST articles are classified as NntpPost (peerable), including SmtpListId articles that should be local-only. Implement AUTHINFO USER/PASS drain credentials: drain authenticates with a shared secret, reader session recognises authenticated drain sessions and trusts the injection source header only from those sessions.
